title: Elf Bar Elfa Pro Apple Peach Prefilled Pod 20mg - 2 Pack
description: Apple Peach from Elfa is a wickedly full-flavoured fruity blend of crisp, fresh Apples and sweet, juicy, sun-ripened Peaches for a perfect taste of an endless summer. The ELFA Pro Pod Kit from Elf Bar is the next evolution of the bestselling Elfa Prefilled Disposable Pod Kit and your new go-to for an exceptionally satisfying and simple vaping experience. Compact yet powerful, this sleek vape pen houses a long-lasting, rechargeable battery so you can vape all day long without worrying about finding the next charging point. Prefilled Disposable with 2ml of e-liquid and 20mg of nicotine salt e-liquid, these Elfa Pro pods offer a diverse range of delicious flavours for you to try. And the best part? They're quick and easy to change, making it simple to switch up your vaping experience whenever you fancy something new Plus, the pods are easy to see through, so you'll never have to guess when it's time for a pod change. But it's not just the variety of flavours that makes these pods special. Thanks to the integrated QUAQ mesh coil technology, you can expect even faster heat-up times and more efficient e-liquid vaporisation. That means more intensely delicious flavour with every puff. Each pod includes 2ml of e-liquid with 20mg of salt nicotine content, offering smooth, satisfying puffs that can keep cravings at bay for longer. The pods are sold in packs of two, so you'll always have a spare on hand when you need it. Please note: To activate your new Elfa Pro prefilled pod, first remove the stickers from the base and the side and remove the silicon plug in the mouthpiece, then gently press the base of the pod upwards. This allows the e-liquid to flow into the chamber and come into contact with the coil. Then simply insert the Elfa Pro Pod into the battery component. We recommend allowing the activated pod to sit for approx. 5 minutes to avoid any dry or burnt hits.
